verses.english: “Mendicants, these two misrepresent the Realized One.

verses.pali: Duṭṭho vā dosantaro, saddho vā duggahitena.
verses.english: One who is hateful and hides it, and one whose faith is mistaken.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve tathāgataṁ abbhācikkhantī”ti.
verses.english: These two misrepresent the Realized One.”
